name: Bramblescar
summary: Bramblescar is a heavily fortified Razormane quilboar settlement situated in the southern Barrens. Thick, thorny brambles shield the encampment as its inhabitants wage a brutal war against the rival Bristleback tribe across the Gold Road.

sections.title: A Thorned Redoubt
sections.body: Carved into the jagged, giant briars of the southern Barrens, Bramblescar serves as a vital redoubt for the Razormane quilboar. These defensive brambles grow thick and sharp enough to deter casual wanderers, but the quilboar within are far from peaceful. Fiercely territorial and hostile to outsiders, they mount continuous skirmishes against anyone who ventures near their borders, viewing all non-quilboar as intruders upon land blessed by their ancient boar gods.

sections.title: Tribal Blood Feud
sections.body: Bramblescar sits in perpetual tension directly across the Gold Road from Agama'gor, an encampment held by the rival Bristleback tribe. The two factions are locked in an unrelenting tribal war for dominion over the southern Barrens. Between fighting off Horde travelers along the highway and repelling Bristleback raiding parties, the Razormane warriors of Bramblescar remain on constant, violent alert.

faq.answer: Bramblescar is inhabited by the Razormane tribe of quilboar, who defend their thorn-choked encampment against both rival quilboar and any travelers passing through.

faq.q: Why are the quilboar here fighting each other?
faq.answer: The Razormane of Bramblescar and the Bristleback quilboar across the road at Agama'gor are bitter enemies locked in a fierce territorial blood feud for control of the southern Barrens.
Bramblescar lies in the southern plains of the Barrens, positioned just east of the main Gold Road across from Agama'gor.

faq.q: Are the quilboar here hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. The Razormane quilboar view the Horde as invaders who have encroached on their sacred tribal lands, and they will attack any traveler who wanders close.

angles.text: Securing the Gold Road against quillboar raids from Bramblescar is crucial to maintaining safe passage between Crossroads, Camp Taurajo, and the southern frontier.
